component.name: Source Manager
源管理器
component.summary: Manage the software sources, registries and mirrors of every ecosystem
统一管理这台电脑上所有软件的下载源与镜像

description.p: A plugin-based source/registry/mirror manager for Linux: see and switch the download source of APT, npm, Yarn, pnpm, pip, Cargo, Go, Flatpak, Docker, Git, Maven, RubyGems and Conda from one place, measure which mirror is fastest right now, and undo everything (every change is snapshotted first).
一个插件化的软件源/镜像管理器：在一处查看并切换 APT、npm、Yarn、pnpm、pip、Cargo、Go、 Flatpak、Docker、Git、Maven、RubyGems、Conda 的下载源，实测哪个镜像最快， 并且所有修改都可以撤销（改前自动备份）。

Note: inside the Flatpak sandbox only the ecosystems that live in your home directory can be changed; system-wide sources (APT, Docker) are read-only here and the app tells you the exact command to run on the host.
